rows.en: Hold out until the enemy ship stops
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: The United Space Force is moving to retake <pic(0)><cs(3)>Amaterasu<ce()>, held by the Martian Successors.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: For this operation, the enemy strike force deployed around Earth has to be pinned down.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: Our mission this time is to hit that strike force and support the United Space Force.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: We already know their <mk(-50,-50,3,1)>hideout. It is an <pic(1)><cs(3)>abandoned colony<ce()> near Amaterasu.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: It has <mk(62.5,25,7,0)><ar(0,7,0)>no direct link to the E2, but it's an important mission. I expect a lot from you.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: Thanks to your efforts, the operation to retake Amaterasu was a success.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: Since this operation, the Martian Successors have pulled back from the front line.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: But the polar cap ruins on Mars... Unless we strike there, they'll show up again.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: As of today, the Nadesico B is assigned to the mission to bring Mars under control.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: I hear the Nadesico C, being built by <cs(1)>Nergal Heavy Industries<ce()>, will be used to take Mars.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: Losing her will weaken us, but both are important missions. Let's do our very best.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?

rows.en: You are the UCE's last hope. I want you to understand that and act accordingly.
rows.speaker: Commanding officer?
